target.title: fix(ui): remove no-op timer leak in realtime talk mark handler
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `scheduleMarkAck()` method in `realtime-talk-gateway-relay.ts` creates a `window.setTimeout(() => {}, delayMs)` timer that does nothing — the callback is empty and the return value (timer ID) is discarded. This is a timer leak: every relay mark event creates an unreferenced timer that sits in memory until it fires on an empty callback.

## Why This Change Was Made

The mark event from the gateway relay does not require client-side acknowledgment — the relay handles it automatically. The no-op timer was either dead code left from an earlier design or an incomplete feature stub. Keeping it in the hot path wastes timer slots and contributes to memory pressure during prolonged realtime-talk sessions.

## User Impact

- Eliminates timer resource leaks during realtime voice sessions
- Reduces unnecessary runtime overhead from no-op timeout creation
- No user-visible behavior change — mark events continue to be handled as a no-op

## Evidence

### Unit test — mark events no longer create timers

The new test `handles relay mark events without creating timers` creates a real `GatewayRelayRealtimeTalkTransport`, starts it, emits a mark event with a `markName`, and asserts that `setTimeout` is never called:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/realtime-talk-gateway-relay.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.9

 ✓ handles relay mark events without creating timers
 ✓ ... (18 other tests)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

### All realtime-talk regression tests pass (68 tests across 4 files)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/realtime-talk-gateway-relay.test.ts   ui/src/pages/chat/realtime-talk-webrtc.test.ts   ui/src/pages/chat/realtime-talk-google-live.test.ts   ui/src/pages/chat/realtime-talk.test.ts

 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  68 passed (68)
```

### Lint / format / typecheck

- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check`: All matched files use the correct format
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs`: No lint errors (after fixing no-useless-return)
- `pnpm tsgo`: No type errors
- `git diff --check`: PASSED

### OpenClaw starts successfully with patched code

```
$ pnpm openclaw --version
OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (7ee634f)
```

### Before / After

**Before**: Every relay `"mark"` event called `scheduleMarkAck()`, which created `window.setTimeout(() => {}, delayMs)` and discarded the timer ID. Timer resources leaked over the lifetime of a realtime voice session.

**After**: The `scheduleMarkAck` method is removed entirely. The `case "mark"` handler uses `break` (no-op). The gateway relay continues to handle all events (audio, transcript, toolCall, toolResult, close, error) identically — only the dead timer was removed.
